rules.statement: Apply every applicable rule as an obligation, not a suggestion, through research, specification, planning, implementation and review.
Establish compliance in the actual data model, code and evidence. An acknowledgment, a checklist mark or a passing tool is not sufficient.
Do not begin dependent implementation until the minimum necessary data model, ownership, invariants and failure behavior are settled.
Stop affected work when a rule is violated: preserve the state, record the violation, correct it and verify the correction before proceeding.
Never waive a rule silently, and never weaken requirements, tests or evidence to obtain acceptance.
Make valid states explicit and prevent invalid combinations. Complete every approved requirement before claiming completion.
